_comment: What ships: the production staging list for the app build (ET1-17) and tests/_harness.py stage(production=True). files = the bundle, copied as is; then every vendor.json entry. dev_only = never shipped: the demo body (loaded by main.js only for ?demo=) and, by construction, the test fixtures (tests/fixtures, never in ui/). A new file in ui/ must be listed in one of the two (a test checks it).
